description: The bar chart, titled "QA-2," compares the performance of two systems on a question-answering task, with the vertical axis listing the systems and the horizontal axis representing the percentage of responses in three categories: Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect. The legend indicates that the dark purple segment corresponds to "Correct" answers, the medium blue segment to "Partially Correct," and the light blue segment to "Incorrect." The top bar, labeled "RedWhale (our)," shows a breakdown of 95.7% Correct, 1.4% Partially Correct, and 2.9% Incorrect. The bar below it, labeled "RedWhale (our)," shows a breakdown of 92.9% Correct, 2.9% Partially Correct, and 4.3% Incorrect. The chart visually indicates that the top system has a higher percentage of correct answers and a lower percentage of incorrect answers compared to the bottom system.
